concept.title: Getting Started
concept.shortdesc: A quick introduction to and the key concepts you need to know before you begin.

dlentry.dd: A named, persistent chat room. Talks can be public (visible to all users in your organization) or private (invite-only). Each talk retains its full message history.
Anyone with a registered account. Each user is assigned a unique display color used to identify their messages in the talk view.
A private one-on-one conversation between two users, separate from any talk.
A way to notify a specific user within a talk by typing @username. The mentioned user receives a notification even if they are not currently active.

ol.li: Install on your computer, ask your system administrator for help.
Launch the application and create or log in to your account.
On the Talk Selection Screen, choose an existing talk or create a new one.
Start exchanging messages with your team on the Main Talk Screen.
Customize your experience via Settings (notifications, theme, proxy, etc.).
